name: Venice
matter: A famous island city in North Eastern Italy built across more than 100 small islands in a lagoon.
The city is renowned for its iconic flat-bottomed gondolas and centuries-old Venetian Gothic and Byzantine architecture.
It is also globally famous for its vibrant artistic traditions, particularly Carnival celebrations and delicate hand-blown Murano glass.

name: Florence
matter: Florence is universally celebrated as the birthplace of the Italian Renaissance.
Its historic center is dominated by Brunelleschi’s massive terracotta dome atop the Florence Cathedral (the Duomo)
The city houses world-famous artistic masterpieces, including Michelangelo’s David and Botticelli’s The Birth of Venus.

name: Rome
matter: Rome spans nearly three millennia of history, earning its title as the Eternal City and the cradle of Western civilization.
Ancient monuments like the Colosseum and the Roman Forum stand seamlessly integrated alongside bustling modern streets.
It encloses Vatican City, the world's smallest independent state and the global heart of the Catholic Church.

name: Milan
matter: Home to luxury brands like Armani, Prada and Versace who host world famous events like Milan fashion week
As Italy's financial and business centre Milan is also famous for its fierce football rivalry between AC Milan and Inter Milan
Leonardo Da Vinci's famous 15th century mural The last supper is housed in the city's Convent of Santa Maria Delle Grazie
